event_description: Whether on the page, stage or screen, American Comedy Award-winning comedian Paula Poundstone uproariously entertains with her unique blend of incisive and spontaneous humor. She can be heard weekly on her comedy podcast, Nobody Listens to Paula Poundstone, and has lent her hilarious wit and wisdom to NPR’s award-winning “Wait, Wait...Don’t Tell Me!” and to the 92nd EMMY Awards as a live correspondent. Poundstone was also the first woman ever to perform at the White House Correspondents’ Dinner. Her much lauded HBO specials, bestselling books and countless guest appearances have cemented her legendary comedic status. Don’t miss this priceless evening with one of Comedy Central’s 100 Best Standup Comics of All Time! May contain adult language and themes.

event_description: Winter Program - Puppet Theater The Storytelling Guild partners with Craterian Performances to bring two free performances to local children. A professional puppet theater group is hired for these performances to give children, many who would not otherwise be able to attend the theater, a chance to enjoy a professional performance at no cost. Winter Program exposes children to another form of storytelling, through the magic of puppets. Children are asked to bring a book donation to this event to be distributed with our ‘Pass the Book’ program. Baba Yaga Performed by Pegasus Puppet Theatre from Portland, Oregon Sunday, February 2, 2025​Performance times 1:00 and 3:30 PM Craterian Theater, Collier Center for the Performing Arts 23 South Central Avenue, Medford OR ​ FREE ADMISSION A donation of new or gently used children's books at the door is much appreciated for our Book Drive. The Storytelling Guild collects hundreds of books to distribute in our community through Pass The Book.​Sponsored by the Storytelling Guild and Craterian Performances ​ Description: Adapted from the children’s book by Ernest Small, this Slavic story of Baba Yaga features a curmudgeonly witch with a taste for bad children, a hedgehog prince who travels through the forest on his noble rooster, and a little girl named Marusia who is in search of turnips. As Marusia and her friend the hedgehog match wits with Baba Yaga, the most marvelous story unfolds with magical brews, a treacherous dragon, ​and Baba’s outrageous house on chicken legs. Music and lyrics by Richard Moore! This production is in English but includes some Russian words and phrases.​Grades K-6 Program length: 50 minutes. Post-show demo and Q&A, if time allows.

event_description: Love will find a way!!! Enjoy a night of easy rock and help support upcoming musicians in the Rogue Valley. Proceeds from this event will benefit the Use Your Gift Foundation. Pablo Cruise in concert - VIP Experience Available* Multi-Platinum Selling & Internationally Acclaimed Pop/Rock Band PABLO CRUISE released their first album in 1975, welcoming fans to "Climb Aboard The Good Ship Pablo Cruise." Reaching the Top 10 with mega hits like "Whatcha Gonna Do When She Says Goodbye?" & "Love Will Find A Way," and several other Top 20's, the band went on to sell several million albums. In 1979, they broke Elvis Presley's attendance record at the Sahara Tahoe in South Lake Tahoe, Nevada, becoming the first rock band to play a casino, but by 1985 after releasing 8 studio albums (2 Platinum - 'A Place in the Sun' & 'Worlds Away'), the band decided to take a hiatus that lasted nearly 20 years. Today, Pablo Cruise is bringing more energy & excitement to the stage than ever before and never sounded better. Band includes Founders DAVID JENKINS (Guitar, Vocals) & CORY LERIOS (Keys, Vocals) as well as ROBBIE WYCKOFF (Vocals, Percussion - toured w/Roger Waters for 5 years), SERGIO GONZALEZ (Drums) & LARRY ANTONINO (Bass). *A limited number of VIP Experience tickets are available for $100.00 each. VIP Tickets include Premium Seats (first two rows), Meet & Greet with the band from 6:00 to 7:00 with beer, wine and snacks. Opening act: Use Your Gift Foundation artist Amber Lyn. Amber Lyn is an award-winning singer-songwriter from Southern Oregon with a story as powerful as her music. Abandoned by her father at a young age and raised by a single mother who left her feeling unsupported and small, Amber grew up doubting her worth and suppressing her voice. It wasn’t until she unexpectedly received a songwriting award that she discovered her ability to write songs and sing—a gift that has since transformed her life and the lives of many others.

event_description: TICKETS ON SALE FEBRUARY 21ST! Rock. It Boy Entertainment of America presents arrival: Canada’s TRIBUTE TO ABBA with Dreams: The Ultimate TRIBUTE Fleetwood Mac ARRIVAL is Canada's Tribute to ABBA. The six-piece ensemble delivers an authentic sound with full costumes, reminiscent of styles worn by the original. This band of professional musicians has played hundreds of sold-out shows all around the world. As you relive such favorites as “Mama Mia”, “Dancing Queen”, “Fernando”, “Chiquitita”, and “Knowing Me, Knowing You” you will be amazed at how close Arrival-Canada's tribute to Abba looks and sounds to the original pop icon. Take a trip back in time and experience this amazing music all over again! For more about ARRIVAL please visit tributetoabba.com. DREAMS: THE ULTIMATE TRIBUTE TO FLEETWOOD MAC, is an authentic sounding, six-piece tribute to Fleetwood Mac. They perform in full period costumes. In just a few years this professional ensemble has played hundreds of shows around the globe including a stint in Las Vegas. Regarding DREAMS, Jeff Towers states, “Having worked for the real Fleetwood Mac, I feel Dreams has captured the true essence & vibe that is often missing from tribute acts. They definitely let you sink into the music & experience the Fleetwood Mac vibe.” Hearing their spot-on delivery of “You Make Loving Fun”, “Dreams”, “Don’t Stop”, “Rhiannon”, “Second Hand News”, “Say You Love Me”, and “Go Your Own Way”, you will know why DREAMS is the “Ultimate Tribute to Fleetwood Mac”. For more about DREAMS please visit tributetofleetwoodmac.ca.

event_description: Youth Symphony of Southern Oregon Fall Concert Series Performance November 9, 2025, 3:00 p.m. Craterian Theater at the Collier Center, Medford The Youth Symphony of Southern Oregon will present a performance at the Collier Center’s Craterian Theater at 3PM on Sunday, November 9, 2025. The concert will showcase the musicians of the Youth Symphony and the Youth Orchestra playing works by Ludwig van Beethoven, Jacques Offenbach, Edward Elgar, Richard Strauss, and others. The featured Youth Symphony work on the Fall Concert Series program will be Scene de Ballet, Op. 100 by Charles-Auguste de Bériot. The violin soloist will be 2025 Concerto Competition winner Amelia Hill. The Youth Symphony and the Youth Orchestra will be led by the YSSO organization’s new music director and conductor Nathanael Hooper. Founded in 1988, the Youth Symphony of Southern Oregon is a regional organization offering high level, challenging orchestral music opportunities, a competition for advanced players, and solo and chamber music experiences. Participation in the YSSO develops technical, interpretive, and performance skills, cultivates lifelong friendships, and nurtures skills such as focus, discipline, and teamwork. event_description: The Storytelling Guild partners with Craterian Performances to bring two free performances to local children. A professional puppet theater group is hired for these performances to give children, many who would not otherwise be able to attend the theater, a chance to enjoy a professional performance at no cost. Winter Program exposes children to another form of storytelling, through the magic of puppets. Children are asked to bring a book donation to this event to be distributed with our ‘Pass the Book’ program. 'Stone Soup' is an old French folktale in which hungry strangers convince the people of a town to each share a small amount of their food in order to make a meal that everyone enjoys, and exists as a moral regarding the value of sharing. Pegasus Theatre's charming rendition is a musical set in the snowy Arctic. The characters are all indigenous animals, including a clever arctic fox, a lemming, a walrus, puffins, a polar bear, and a magical narwhal. This story inspires the qualities of generosity, coming together as a community, and the value of looking beyond stereotypes. ​ Perfect for kids 3-9. FREE ADMISSION A donation of new or gently used children's books at the door is much appreciated for our Book Drive. The Storytelling Guild collects hundreds of books to distribute in our community through Pass The Book.​Sponsored by the Storytelling Guild and Craterian Performances

event_description: For over a decade, John Craigie has made music that brings people in, not with spectacle but with sincerity and songs that feel like conversations. His new album I Swam Here was written and produced by Craigie and recorded between New Orleans and Astoria. Seven tracks were cut at Deslonde St Studios with musicians handpicked by Sam Doores of The Deslondes. Following 2024’s Pagan Church, which spent six weeks at #1 on the Americana Albums chart, I Swam Here feels both expansive and intimate, shaped by the musical history of the Gulf Coast and the stillness of the Pacific Northwest. The first Blind Pilot album in eight years, In the Shadow of the Holy Mountain emerged from a period of artistic crisis and the radical transformation of their creative ecosystem. “I went through a few years where I wasn’t able to write—I tried therapy, I read books on writer’s block, I went on writing trips, but nothing was helping,” says Israel Nebeker, frontman for the Oregon-bred band. After stepping back and reimagining his songwriting approach, Nebeker challenged himself to write an entire album in a month, then brought those songs to his bandmates with a newfound sense of receptivity. “I told myself that whatever songs came through in that month would be for the love of the band and music we make together,” says Nebeker. “Instead of being controlling in the studio, I wanted to let the songs live and breathe with the band as an entity. By the time we finished, it was the most joy we’d ever had in making an album together.”

event_description: About Alice in Wonderland by International Ballet Stars A spectacular World Premiere production, Alice in Wonderland reimagines Lewis Carroll's beloved story through a bold, wildly imaginative artistic vision - featuring breathtaking sets and costumes designed in collaboration with world-renowned artist Romero Britto. This one-of-a- kind production pushes the boundaries of classical ballet, blending the elegance of a world- class cast with the visual spectacle of Broadway-style theatrical design, and the vibrant energy of pop art. The result is a new form of live entertainment that amazes, surprises, and transports audiences into a world unlike anything they've seen on stage. Step into a magical world where imagination comes alive. Audiences follow Alice down the rabbit hole into a surreal wonderland bursting with color, fantasy, and theatrical charm - from a charming Mad Hatter to a delightfully parodic Queen of Hearts. Each scene explodes with immersive visuals, extraordinary characters, and the grace and power of an international cast of ballet stars representing leading ballet traditions from around the world, including Spain, Brazil, Poland, Ukraine, the United Kingdom, Italy, Austria, Georgia, Iceland, Japan, Moldova, Romania, Belarus, Armenia, Mongolia, and Albania. With its sophisticated storytelling, bold visual design, and captivating performances, Alice in Wonderland enchants children and adults alike. Duration: 2 hours (including 20-minute intermission) Suggested for Audiences ages 3 and over

event_description: Bluebird Improv A collection of legendary comedians touring the world, Bluebird Improv performs shows that are fully-improvised, once-in-a-lifetime experiences! Made up of some of comedy’s most recognizable faces from TV and movies, as well as some that will become your new favorites, Bluebird was formed out of a shared, burning love for improvising and entertaining audiences. The cast rotates, and for this show will include: Matt Walsh (Veep, Ghosts), Joe Canale (Mindy Project), Brad Morris (AP Bio), and Marc Evan Jackson (The Good Place, Brooklyn 99). A short conversation with a couple of audience members at the top of the show inspires the spontaneous, unhinged, and beautifully hilarious comedy mayhem that ensues!
